controls: Empirical centered covariance, symmetric empirical residuals, signed query bias, horizon bias and ridge; all source fitted
coupled_arm: NEW source-estimated block-normalized correlation with fixed 0.5 identity shrinkage; not an existing joint Bayesian posterior
heldout_query_scope: No query-specific readout calibration for far-marker pairs or odd-center bends; generic field covariance may use complete source geometry
limitations: Only two real objects; retrospective analysis, not independent confirmation.
The source-coupled extension is an empirical covariance extension, not evidence for uniquely Bayesian inference.
Quadratic-query gains cannot establish higher-order posterior value or latent physical-state accuracy.
Recorded boundary inputs are shared; no robot or new physical action was used.
mean_model_shift: Source controls use eight out-of-fit predictions from the 39-fit parent; evaluation uses the parent all-56 refit. No test outcome enters a fit. This source-to-target predictor change is retained, not concealed.
native_covariance: 3x3 within-marker blocks; no native cross-marker covariance
statistical_unit: complete trajectory resampled within each of two FIXED DLO objects; no arbitrary-object population inference
target_loader: Exact parent float32 transpose and z>=0.002001 preprocessing; not pristine raw geometry
